versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-multi-platform-video-to-text.
- Converts video/audio files or platform links (Douyin, Xiaohongshu, etc.) into clean, structured text using Qianwen language model.
- Removes filler words, mistakes, and repetitions; supports custom prompts for summaries, rewrites, key quotes, translations, and more.
- Supports most major video/audio formats (mp4, mov, avi, mp3, etc.).
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for use; processes files securely and deletes them after analysis.
- Output is ready-to-use copywriting suitable for meeting notes, summaries, creative scripts, and social media posts.
